honesty: First-live lane ranks RH-placeable single-leg DNA. CSP/wheel seats need fit_3k short-premium collateral within the $3k sleeve; long-debit seats still use the ~10% sleeve path max-loss bar ($300 default). Multi-leg PCS research leaders are intentionally excluded. Proxy sim + spot BP — not live edge or target trade risk.

leader.caveat: Proxy sim + spot BP only. Not pack-grade multi-symbol edge. RH MCP single-leg place still requires Ken arm for live. CSP collateral is gated by sleeve fit_3k, not the $300 defined-risk bar.
leader.why: single-leg cash_secured_put on SNAP; fits $3k sleeve collateral (CSP/wheel); sim SHIP n=131
